question: Should OpenClaw add a `HEARTBEAT.md` task-level model metadata contract, or should task-specific model routing wait for a broader routing API/plugin design?
rationale: Source inspection proves the capability is missing, but the implementation shape changes public heartbeat syntax and model/provider routing semantics that need maintainer intent.

options.title: Design shared routing contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open and decide a reusable heartbeat/per-turn routing contract before accepting heartbeat-only syntax.

options.title: Add heartbeat-only metadata
options.body: Implement a narrow `HEARTBEAT.md` task `model` field with explicit split/group semantics, model alias/fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Decline core task syntax
options.body: Route whole-turn model policy to `before_model_resolve` plugins or cron per-job models and accept that current heartbeat batches cannot independently route due tasks.

recommendation.title: Design shared routing contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and decide a reusable heartbeat/per-turn routing contract before accepting heartbeat-only syntax.

likelyOwner.reason: He has adjacent model-hook provenance and prior product-boundary review context for model-routing scope.
